Then Elihu continued:
And Elihu made answer and said,
以利戶又說：
“Hear my words, O wise men; give ear to me, O men of learning.
Give ear, you wise, to my words; and you who have knowledge, give attention to me;
你們智慧人要聽我的話；有知識的人要留心聽我說。
For the ear tests words as the mouth tastes food.
For words are tested by the ear, as food is tasted by the mouth.
因為耳朵試驗話語，好像上膛嘗食物。
Let us choose for ourselves what is right; let us learn together what is good.
Let us make the decision for ourselves as to what is right; let us have the knowledge among ourselves of what is good.
我們當選擇何為是，彼此知道何為善。
For Job has declared, ‘I am righteous, yet God has deprived me of justice.
For Job has said, I am upright, and it is God who has taken away my right;
約伯曾說：我是公義，神奪去我的理；
Would I lie about my case? My wound is incurable, though I am without transgression.’
Though I am right, still I am in pain; my wound may not be made well, though I have done no wrong.
我雖有理，還算為說謊言的；我雖無過，受的傷還不能醫治。
What man is like Job, who drinks up derision like water?
What man is like Job, a man who freely makes sport of God,
誰像約伯，喝譏誚如同喝水呢？
He keeps company with evildoers and walks with wicked men.
And goes in the company of evil-doers, walking in the way of sinners?
他與作孽的結伴，和惡人同行。
For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight in God.’
For he has said, It is no profit to a man to take delight in God.
他說：人以神為樂，總是無益。
Therefore listen to me, O men of understanding. Far be it from God to do wrong, and from the Almighty to act unjustly.
Now then, you wise, take note; you men of knowledge, give ear to me. Let it be far from God to do evil, and from the Ruler of all to do wrong.
所以，你們明理的人要聽我的話。神斷不致行惡；全能者斷不致作孽。
For according to a man’s deeds He repays him; according to a man’s ways He brings consequences.
For he gives to every man the reward of his work, and sees that he gets the fruit of his ways.
他必按人所做的報應人，使各人照所行的得報。
Indeed, it is true that God does not act wickedly, and the Almighty does not pervert justice.
Truly, God does not do evil, and the Ruler of all is not a false judge.
神必不作惡；全能者也不偏離公平。
Who gave Him charge over the earth? Who appointed Him over the whole world?
Who put the earth into his care, or made him responsible for the world?
誰派他治理地，安定全世界呢？
If He were to set His heart to it and withdraw His Spirit and breath,
If he made his spirit come back to him, taking his breath into himself again,
他若專心為己，將靈和氣收歸自己，
all flesh would perish together and mankind would return to the dust.
All flesh would come to an end together, and man would go back to the dust.
凡有血氣的就必一同死亡；世人必仍歸塵土。
If you have understanding, hear this; listen to my words.
If you are wise, take note of this; give ear to the voice of my words.
你若明理，就當聽我的話，留心聽我言語的聲音。
Could one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn the just and mighty One,
How may a hater of right be a ruler? and will you say that the upright Ruler of all is evil?
難道恨惡公平的可以掌權嗎？那有公義的、有大能的，豈可定他有罪嗎？
who says to kings, ‘You are worthless!’ and to nobles, ‘You are wicked,’
He who says to a king, You are an evil-doer; and to rulers, You are sinners;
他對君王說：你是鄙陋的；對貴臣說：你是邪惡的。
who is not partial to princes and does not favor rich over poor? For they are all the work of His hands.
Who has no respect for rulers, and who gives no more attention to those who have wealth than to the poor, for they are all the work of his hands.
他待王子不徇情面，也不看重富足的過於貧窮的，因為都是他手所造。
They die in an instant, in the middle of the night. The people convulse and pass away; the mighty are removed without human hand.
Suddenly they come to an end, even in the middle of the night: the blow comes on the men of wealth, and they are gone, and the strong are taken away without the hand of man.
在轉眼之間，半夜之中，他們就死亡。百姓被震動而去世；有權力的被奪去非借人手。
For His eyes are on the ways of a man, and He sees his every step.
For his eyes are on the ways of a man, and he sees all his steps.
神注目觀看人的道路，看明人的腳步。
There is no darkness or deep shadow where the workers of iniquity can hide.
There is no dark place, and no thick cloud, in which the workers of evil may take cover.
沒有黑暗、陰翳能給作孽的藏身。
For God need not examine a man further or have him approach for judgment.
For he does not give man a fixed time to come before him to be judged.
神審判人，不必使人到他面前再三鑒察。
He shatters the mighty without inquiry and sets up others in their place.
He sends the strong to destruction without searching out their cause, and puts others in their place.
他用難測之法打破有能力的人，設立別人代替他們。
Therefore, He recognizes their deeds; He overthrows them in the night and they are crushed.
For he has knowledge of their works, overturning them in the night, so that they are crushed.
他原知道他們的行為，使他們在夜間傾倒滅亡。
He strikes them for their wickedness in full view,
The evil-doers are broken by his wrath, he puts his hand on them with force before the eyes of all onlookers.
他在眾人眼前擊打他們，如同擊打惡人一樣。
because they turned aside from Him and had no regard for any of His ways.
Because they did not go after him, and took no note of his ways,
因為他們偏行不跟從他，也不留心他的道，
They caused the cry of the poor to come before Him, and He heard the outcry of the afflicted.
So that the cry of the poor might come up to him, and the prayer of those in need come to his ears.
甚至使貧窮人的哀聲達到他那裡；他也聽了困苦人的哀聲。
But when He remains silent, who can condemn Him? When He hides His face, who can see Him? Yet He watches over both man and nation,
他使人安靜，誰能擾亂（或譯：定罪）呢？他掩面，誰能見他呢？無論待一國或一人都是如此─
that godless men should not rule or lay snares for the people.
使不虔敬的人不得作王，免得有人牢籠百姓。
Suppose someone says to God, ‘I have endured my punishment; I will offend no more.
有誰對神說：我受了責罰，不再犯罪；
Teach me what I cannot see; if I have done wrong, I will not do it again.’
我所看不明的，求你指教我；我若作了孽，必不再作？
Should God repay you on your own terms when you have disavowed His? You must choose, not I; so tell me what you know.
他施行報應，豈要隨你的心願、叫你推辭不受嗎？選定的是你，不是我。你所知道的只管說吧！
Men of understanding will declare to me, and the wise men who hear me will say:
Men of knowledge, and all wise men, hearing me, will say,
明理的人和聽我話的智慧人必對我說：
‘Job speaks without knowledge; his words lack insight.’
Job's words do not come from knowledge; they are not the fruit of wisdom.
約伯說話沒有知識，言語中毫無智慧。
If only Job were tried to the utmost for answering like a wicked man.
May Job be tested to the end, because his answers have been like those of evil men.
願約伯被試驗到底，因他回答像惡人一樣。
For he adds rebellion to his sin; he claps his hands among us and multiplies his words against God.”
For in addition to his sin, he is uncontrolled in heart; before our eyes he makes sport of God, increasing his words against him.
他在罪上又加悖逆；在我們中間拍手，用許多言語輕慢神。
